gloss: to rustle about; to rummage; to fumble around

definitions.gloss: to rustle about; to rummage; to fumble around
definitions.explanation: To make rustling sounds while searching through things or moving around restlessly. An onomatopoeic word describing the sound and action of rummaging.

examples.japanese: カバンの{中|なか}をごそごそした。
examples.english: I rummaged around in my bag.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}の{部屋|へや}でごそごそ{音|おと}がする。
examples.english: I can hear rustling sounds from the next room.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{押|お}し{入|い}れの{奥|おく}をごそごそと{探|さが}して、{古|ふる}いアルバムを{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: He rummaged around in the back of the closet and pulled out an old album.

notes:
An onomatopoeic (giongo) word that imitates the sound of rustling or shuffling. Can be used as ごそごそする (verb), ごそごそと (adverb with と), or just ごそごそ (adverb without と).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ごそごそ{探|さが}す: to rummage and search
- ごそごそ{音|おと}がする: to hear rustling sounds
- ごそごそと{動|うご}く: to move about restlessly
- ポケットをごそごそする: to fumble in one's pocket

SIMILAR ONOMATOPOEIA:
- がさがさ: rustling — louder, rougher rustling sound
- もそもそ: mumbling/shuffling — slower, more muffled movement
- ごろごろ: rolling/rumbling — heavier movement or thunder
